prefix.description: Prefix of every object name, e.g. `ai_`. May be empty.

jobs_table.description: Name of the jobs table after the prefix. Its functions are named <prefix><jobs_table>_enqueue, _claim, _heartbeat, _finish, _mark_attempt, _reclaim and _sweep.

scope_column.description: Column holding the scope id, the thing there is one pending job per.

scope_type.description: SQL type of the scope id.

server_role.description: The Hasura role that alone may call the queue's functions (the server's own).
